title: Large Language Models in Qualitative Research: Uses, Tensions, and Intentions

bias_targets.methodology: Thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews with qualitative researchers regarding their concerns about Western bias embedded in LLM training data and its impact on marginalized groups.

Thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews documenting researchers' concerns about LLMs misinterpreting data from non-English-speaking populations or mistranscribing important community language.
Qualitative evaluation through interviews where researchers recounted specific experiences of LLMs negatively misinterpreting participant data, such as falsely identifying queer content as hateful.
Qualitative evaluation through interviews where participants reported that LLMs provided reductive and overly broad generalizations about women from different backgrounds.
